name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - § 54 - Am 95
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 54 a. Expresses strong concerns regarding the breaches of the asylum acquis by various Member States; calls on the Commission to urgently verify the compliance of laws with the EU asylum acquis and the Charter of Fundamental Rights of the EU and to use all tools at its disposal to stop violations; calls for solidarity between Member States to be ensured in the context of relocations of asylum seekers and to refrain from externalisation of EU’s borders.
